decision_reasons: All 18 normalized release-critical metrics have primary or authoritative support appropriate to their role and complete code/test mappings.
REG-CI95-001 maps the exact two-sided 95% t interval and its N-k parameterization to public-summary code and a numerical test covering both constant conventions.
REG-NOCONSTANT-001 maps public Total df=N and Total MS=TSS/N to the exact rendered-summary test.
Mathematical sources and software-compatibility documentation are explicitly separated.
Primary sources, authoritative documentation, source locations, and tests were accessible, so BLOCKED_ENV does not apply.
